title: Load a synthetic persona and view the dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can choose a synthetic sample trader persona and see the dashboard load with portfolio summary, findings, and trade explorer content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose a persona from the available options
Verify the dashboard shows performance metrics and trade analysis content
Verify findings and trade explorer content are displayed

title: Upload a completed tradebook and view the dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can upload a completed tradebook CSV and see the dashboard load with analysis results.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the completed tradebook CSV upload data source
Upload a valid completed tradebook CSV file
Verify the dashboard shows performance metrics and trade analysis content
Verify the trade log or explorer content is displayed

title: Load an uploaded tradebook and inspect the analyzed dashboard
description: This test verifies that a user can upload a completed tradebook CSV and see the app accept it and render the resulting analysis views.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the uploaded tradebook data source
Upload a valid completed tradebook CSV file
Verify the uploaded dataset is accepted
Verify the dashboard displays performance metrics and trade findings

title: Review overall portfolio performance metrics
description: This verifies that the dashboard summarizes the loaded tradebook with the key portfolio performance metrics users need.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose a persona from the available options
Verify the dashboard shows net performance, win rate, completed trade count, average trade performance, and charges metrics

title: Inspect a ranked finding and its supporting evidence
description: This verifies that a user can open a ranked behavioral finding and review the qualifying trades, calculations, and checklist that justify it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose a persona from the available options
Expand a ranked finding's evidence section
Expand the evaluated checklist for that finding
Verify qualifying trade evidence is displayed
Verify the behavioral checklist is displayed

title: Filter the completed trade log by outcome and expiry type
description: This test verifies that a user can narrow the completed trade log using outcome and expiry filters and see the table update to matching trades only.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a trader dataset
Switch to the completed trade log view
Select a specific outcome filter
Select a specific expiry type filter
Verify the trade log updates to show matching trades only
Verify non-matching trades are no longer displayed

title: Review the supporting calculations behind a finding
description: This verifies that opening a finding reveals trade-level calculations that explain why the pattern was surfaced.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose a persona from the available options
Expand a ranked finding's evidence section
Verify trade-level calculations are displayed
Verify qualifying trade evidence is displayed

title: Review daily breakdown and pacing for a loaded dataset
description: This test verifies that a user can switch to the daily breakdown view and review the activity summary by day for a loaded trader dataset.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a trader dataset
Switch to the daily breakdown and pacing view
Verify the daily activity summary is displayed
Verify the breakdown reflects activity grouped by day

title: Review evidence and checklist for a ranked finding
description: This test verifies that a user can open a ranked finding and inspect the supporting evidence table and checklist that justify the pattern.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a trader dataset
Open a ranked finding
Expand the evidence table
Expand the supporting checklist
Verify the evidence-backed trade details are displayed
Verify the checklist guidance is displayed

title: Compare two synthetic personas
description: This verifies that switching between synthetic personas reloads the dashboard with a different trade profile and analysis content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose one persona from the available options
Choose a different persona from the available options
Verify the dashboard updates to a different loaded dataset
Verify the portfolio summary and findings reflect the selected persona

title: Commit to a recommended habit rule for next month
description: This test verifies that a user can select a recommended rule and commit to monitoring it next month, resulting in the commitment being recorded in the session.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a trader dataset
Select a recommended rule from the list
Commit to monitoring the selected rule next month
Verify the commitment is recorded in the session
Verify the selected rule is shown as committed

title: Commit to a habit rule and download the action plan
description: This verifies that a user can choose a recommended habit rule, commit to it for next month, and download the 30-day markdown action plan.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose a persona from the available options
Select a recommended habit rule
Commit to monitoring it next month
Download the 30-day action plan
Verify the habit commitment is recorded in the dashboard
Verify the action plan download is available

title: Compare findings across different synthetic personas
description: This test verifies that a user can switch between synthetic personas and see the dashboard update to a different set of summary metrics and findings.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose one persona from the available sample traders
Choose a different persona from the available sample traders
Verify the dashboard updates to a different persona's performance summary
Verify the findings content changes for the selected persona

title: Download the 30-day action plan after selecting a rule
description: This test verifies that a user can select a recommended rule and download the markdown action plan for the next 30 days.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a trader dataset
Select a recommended rule from the list
Download the 30-day action plan in PDF or Word format
Verify the action plan download is initiated
Verify the PDF and Word action plans are available for download

title: No finding appears when the dataset has no pattern
description: This verifies that when the loaded dataset does not trigger a behavioral pattern, the findings area stays empty or shows no qualifying finding.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose a persona from the available options that does not trigger a pattern
Verify no qualifying finding is surfaced

title: Handle a dataset with no clear pattern findings
description: This test verifies that the app shows an empty or no-pattern state when a loaded dataset does not produce ranked findings.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Load a dataset with no clear pattern findings
Verify an empty state or no-pattern message is displayed
Verify the dashboard still shows the available trade summary

title: Reset transient state when switching datasets
description: This verifies that session-only data such as a prior habit commitment or uploaded tradebook is cleared when the user switches to a different dataset source.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the completed tradebook CSV upload data source
Upload a valid completed tradebook CSV file
Select the synthetic sample trader data source
Choose a persona from the available options
Verify the previously loaded uploaded dataset is no longer shown
Verify the dashboard reflects the newly selected persona dataset

title: Reject unsupported trade types in an uploaded tradebook
description: This test verifies that an uploaded tradebook containing unsupported overnight or short-first option trades is rejected with validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the uploaded tradebook data source
Upload a tradebook containing unsupported overnight or short-first trades
Verify a validation error is displayed
Verify the invalid tradebook is not loaded into the dashboard
